text: Bitcoin's mild pullback masks steady positioning at elevated levels, while Ethereum's sharper 2.9% decline suggests profit-taking among altcoin holders despite greed conditions. Bitcoin dominance holding firm at 58.8% with $92B in daily volume indicates confidence in the largest asset, though the divergence between BTC and ETH performance signals selective rather than broad-based strength. Fear & Greed sitting at 71 without movement over a week points to a plateau in momentum—neither capitulation nor euphoria is driving the market currently.
